reason: Checked every entry to draw_column.cell: it is referenced nowhere else (the next-cell path of the loop at ~1795 does its own inline cell test, the other 'cell' labels are in kindcache_build/shield_hi scopes), so entry is fall-through from STA d_ptr+1 only. Just before: LDA col_ptr+1 ; ADC #&FF gives C=1 iff col_ptr+1 + C_in >= 1, true whenever col_ptr+1 >= 1. col_ptr+1 is only set at .known (render.6502:1589) from straight_sprite_hi,X after BNE known (non-zero; sprites are in bank 4 at &80-&B3 high bytes) and thereafter only incremented (INC col_ptr+1 in empty_hi / on_same_page), so it never reaches 0. STA and TYA leave C, so SBC rows_m1 sees C=1 exactly as after SEC; A, N, Z, C, V results identical; SEC touched nothing else (V, D, registers, memory). Both exits (BCS last_cell, EOR/STA rows_m1 into byte loop with C=0) unchanged; stack unaffected; an interrupt between instructions would save/restore flags via RTI so cannot differ (no SEC-dependent state held across an IRQ that the old code did not also hold). Decimal mode: SED is used only in timer/timer_bonus logic, and the preceding ADCs and the SBC address arithmetic would already be wrong in D=1 in the old code. The page-slide of 1 byte is outside this lens (gate's concern).
